en.bilal-muhammad: Ahmad b. Muhammad b. Yahya al-`Attar (rh) narrated to us. He said: My father narrated to us from Ja`far b. Muhammad al-Fazari from `Abbad b. Ya`qub from Mansur b. Abi Nuwayra from Abi Bakr b. `Ayash from Abi Qudama al-Fadani. He said: The Messenger of Allah (s) said:
Whoever is blessed by Allah with the recognition of my Ahl al-Bayt and their wilaya, Allah will gather all goodness for him.
